text:
Linh Tran: Quick heads-up — planning a retention cutover for SIEM exports. Non-PII event retention goes 90d -> 30d next Wed. Need RBAC and KMS rotation work lined up. Who's on this?
Samir Patel: @Linh noted. what's the reason? cost, compliance, or both?
Linh Tran: Mostly cost for long tails + we want parity with enterprise customers who requested shorter retention for reduced surface. Also reduces e-discovery blast radius.
Jessica O'Neill: For vuln triage, we rely on 90d sometimes. Any exemption path for security investigations?
Mark Wu: We should add a two-week cold window for high-severity incident snapshots before trimming. That buys triage time.
Linh Tran: Good idea. Proposal: 30d standard, 14d high-sev snapshot (manual hold), archive policy for legal holds. We also need KMS-step: rotate export CMK and ensure analysts can't unwrap without a ticket.
Samir Patel: How do we handle SIEM streaming consumers? Any backpressure or rehydration plan?
Jessica O'Neill: Add a read-only 'archive-replay' role scoped to a dedicated key with JIT unwrap via key-manager. Engineers shouldn't get unwrap perms.
Mark Wu: Suggested RBAC changes:
- Remove broad splunk-exporter role from devs
- Add splunk-exporter-service (svc acct) for streaming writes
- Add audit-view-30d role for product support
- Add incident-archive-access for sec ops (timeboxed)
sec-bot: ip-allowlist update trigger: a PR modifying splunk-exporter role was opened by @Mark Wu — https://git.example/repo/policy/pull/42 :gear:
Samir Patel: KMS question: Can we rotate CMK without breaking existing archived objects? We need key versioning + rewrap.
Linh Tran: Plan is: create new CMK, update exporter to use new key for new data. For existing archives, keep old key (retire, not destroy) until legal retention expires. Then schedule destroy after signoff.
Jessica O'Neill: For incident response: runbook update needed. Add steps: how to request a hold, how to escalate to legal, and how to request temporary unwrap.
Mark Wu: Do we want an automated hold API? e.g.,
```
POST /internal/logs/holds
{ "selector": "tenant:acme, severity:>=P0", "duration": "14d", "reason": "incident-1234" }
```
Linh Tran: Yes — both UI button (Console) and API. Approval flow: sec-oncall -> security-manager -> legal if >30d.
Samir Patel: Any impact on telemetry dashboards? Lower retention could break some cost/latency graphs that assume 90d window.
Jessica O'Neill: We'll snapshot required dashboards into a metrics store with 90d history before cutover.
Mark Wu: Testing checklist for cutover:
1) dry-run in staging: export with new CMK + retention policy
2) validate RBAC can't unwrap old archives in staging
3) run replay from 14d snapshots into test SIEM
4) legal hold simulation
5) rollback path documented
Linh Tran: Timeline suggestion:
- Mon: final PRs for RBAC + KMS (review)
- Tue: runbook + API endpoints merged
- Wed 02:00 UTC: cutover window (low traffic)
- Wed 03:00 UTC: smoke tests and reconciliation
- Thu: monitor and quick rollback if issues
Samir Patel: Who's owning post-cut monitoring? I can take 24h pager for logs/ingest issues.
Jessica O'Neill: I'll own triage and incident holds.
Mark Wu: I'll own the RBAC rollout and PRs.
Linh Tran: Great. Can @sec-bot add a checklist task for the legal hold consult and tag legal-team?
sec-bot: Created task #SEC-498 (legal hold consult) and pinged @legal-team :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: One more question — encryption-in-transit: does rekey affect streaming socket auth?
Mark Wu: No, only object-level CMK for archived blobs. Streaming TLS certs unchanged.
Jessica O'Neill: Ok — I'll update the triage playbook doc and link it here when done.
Linh Tran: Thanks all. If no blockers, I'll cut the PRs and schedule the window. :thumbsup:
Mark Wu: small follow-up — add a retention-exempt tag for compliance exports so they bypass the 30d rule.
Linh Tran: Yep, we'll add 'retention:exempt' with required approvers.
sec-bot: Reminder — deploy window scheduled for 2024-05-08T02:00:00Z by @Linh Tran
Jessica O'Neill: linking runbook draft: https://docs.example/internal/sec/siem-retention-cutover.md
Samir Patel: Thanks — logging this as incident-prep ticket #ENGSEC-721.
Linh Tran: Closing notes: final approvals needed from security-manager + legal. If anyone needs to demo the archive API, ping me.
Mark Wu: :ok_hand:
